description: Cancel all scheduled jobs matching a specific tag. This is the preferred cleanup mechanism for recurring monitoring and timeout schedules: tag related schedules up front by job or flow (for example: job:<job_id> or flow:<flow_id>) so you can cancel them in one call when the work completes.
embedding_description: Bulk cancel schedules by tag. Cleanup recurring monitoring and timeout schedules. Tag schedules by job or flow (flow_id/job_id) for reliable cleanup. Prevents stale schedules from continuing to fire after the work completes.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Count of schedules cancelled matching the specified tag
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Tagged schedules have been cleared. If the tag covered a timeout or monitoring schedule, confirm the work it watched has reached its terminal state.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Bulk cancelling all scheduled jobs matching a specific tag
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError with 'tag': tag parameter is empty or invalid. SchedulerError: scheduling service unavailable.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For tag errors: provide a non-empty tag string. For scheduler errors: verify the scheduling service is running.
